recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: mostly clear july morning over the bay at twelve degrees
a startup scaling its largest government contract
fake news headlines complaining about fake news in an infinite loop
blogs quietly declaring their dialect in the footer
summer evenings stretching past eight-thirty in san francisco

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Spin up micro-agents from your thumb — each tap deploys a tiny worker that races across a phone screen to patch broken code fragments before sunrise.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Every agent you launch visibly stitches one bug shut; stacking five fixes triggers a satisfying ship animation.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: More broken files appear simultaneously; agents collide and slow unless you tap to reroute them.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal green on midnight blue, iOS shortcut widget vibes

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Ride a stutter-house beat through foggy summer streets — lane-switch between bass drops and silence, matching Fred again..-style glitches to stay in the pocket.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Hit three perfect switches in a row and the track blooms into full volume for two seconds.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Beat stutters get shorter; silent gaps widen; wrong-lane taps mute the mix entirely.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe over wet asphalt, fog rolling off the bay

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort drifting news headlines into real, loop, and echo bins before they pile up and rewrite each other — a meta-feed hygiene puzzle.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Clearing a full stack without a misfile feels like closing every browser tab at once.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Headlines start morphing mid-drag; echo copies spawn if you hesitate too long.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout tabloid clippings on a cork board

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one continuous path through a government-contract maze — your line must touch every checkpoint without crossing itself before the contract deadline timer expires.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Completing a maze in one unbroken stroke unlocks a brief fireworks burst over a blueprint grid.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Checkpoints multiply and the drawable area shrinks; retracing your own line erases progress.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor blueprint, stamped official seals fading in at each checkpoint
